title: A Protocol for the Gravity
author: Mara Delacroix
blurb: Ivo Galloway, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the fleet's truce expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
